text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Severity: p99 latency spike detected for customer CrimsonVault (dedicated pool eu-west-1). P99 crossed SLA threshold 750ms -> 1.9s. Auto-page: oncall-ryan.
ryan: I'm on it, pulling metrics. Can someone grab recent deploys and scale events? @maria @sam
sam: Looking at autoscaler logs now. No recent deploys in last 30m. I see an increase in small-batch inference jobs from tenant ID cv-prod-7.
maria: Confirming p95 elevated too but p99 much worse. graph: /dashboards/crimsonvault/eu-west/latency (shared).
ryan: Can we confirm cache hit rates? If KV cache dropped, tail latency spikes.
alyssa: KV hit rate dropped from 83% -> 41% around 12:10 UTC. TTL churn high. Might be cache eviction storm from a heavy prefix pattern.
kai: Is the dedicated pool saturated? CPU/GPU utilization?
sam: GPU util at 92% on 3/6 nodes, memory pressure moderate. Network QPS for cv-prod-7 doubled.
ryan: Possible tenant overload. Start tenant isolation playbook: redirect cv-prod-7 to a spare warm pool, throttle to 60% of baseline. @maria can you trigger tenant-evict command?
maria: Running evict script now (dry-run first). Command: ```./manage_tenant.sh --evict --tenant cv-prod-7 --target warm-pool-12 --throttle 0.6 --reason "p99 spike"```
incident-bot: action initiated: tenant-evict requested by maria at 12:18 UTC. Tracking ticket INC-7443.
nicole: I informed CrimsonVault support (PV) that we're investigating — they reported higher end-user retry rates. Ticket 122987 opened on their portal.
alyssa: warm-pool-12 has capacity, allocating 2 nodes. Starting traffic drain from pool-a -> warm-pool-12.
sam: Eviction/cutover in progress: live logs: ```Transfer sessions: 412 -> 198 pending```
ryan: Also enabling burst capacity on Dedicated config: set burst_slots=4 for cv-prod account to absorb spikes. Doing now.
incident-bot: config change posted to audit.
maria: KV cache warming: pre-populating common prefixes for CrimsonVault (seed from recent traces). Running script: ```python seeder.py --tenant cv-prod-7 --keys recent```
alyssa: After warm-pool cutover p99 dropped to ~680ms, p95 ~210ms. Still above target for some endpoints.
sam: There's a weird retry pattern: client SDK retrying with backoff 50ms causing request waterfall. Asking solutions to confirm SDK version. @nicole any info from CS?
nicole: Customer running SDK 1.2.0 - there was a config that enables aggressive short-retries. CS asked them to disable retries temporarily. They acknowledged.
kai: To avoid recurrence, let's enable a temporary route rule that sends heavy paths to quantized model variant (lower latency). Propose route rule: if path matches "/generate/short" -> model q4_2 on warm-pool-12.
ryan: Agree. Apply route rule with canary set 10% -> 100% after metrics look good. Apply now?
maria: Applied canary 10% at 12:34 UTC. Monitoring.
alyssa: After canary p99 for canary traffic ~420ms. Overall p99 trending down to 520ms.
ryan: Good. Ramp to 50% for the route.
incident-bot: change recorded. Canaries to 50% at 12:41 UTC.
sam: Observed decrease in KV churn now, hit-rate up to 74%. GPU utilization also dropped to 78%.
nicole: Customer reports reduced retries and improved UX. They asked for ETA on full remediation.
ryan: ETA for full remediation and permanent config: ~30m — we'll finish migrating heavy tenant traffic and keep burst slots for 2 hours. I'll take lead on postmortem. @alyssa you'll coordinate follow-up with infra for autoscaler tuning?
alyssa: On it — will open infra ticket to adjust autoscaler thresholds for CV-specific burst patterns and add cache warming on new sessions.
kai: I'll prepare a targeted quantization recommendation for CrimsonVault for long-term cost/latency balance.
nicole: Sending customer update: "We mitigated the core cause (tenant traffic surge + cache churn); p99 dropped and we have a permanent plan. Will follow up with full incident report"
ryan: Handoff to night on-call: @maria will monitor 02:00-06:00 UTC window. If p99 climbs above 800ms reopen war room.
maria: Acknowledged. I'll keep alerts at higher sensitivity and post hourly updates.
incident-bot: incident resolved->status: contained at 13:00 UTC. Postmortem owner: ryan. Severity: Sev2.
ryan: Thanks team. Postmortem will include timeline, mitigation commands, root cause hypothesis (client retry pattern + cache eviction + saturation), and next steps. I'll include suggested wording for customer comms. :thumbsup:
nicole: I'll follow up with the exact customer communication and schedule an account-technical review.
sam: Saving log snippets and commands to INC-7443 artifact repo.
alyssa: Adding autoscaler tuning task to infra backlog: INFRA-911.
ryan: Closing thread, monitoring window started. We'll update if anything changes.
